AOC 27G11ZE2 27 Inch FHD Fast IPS 240Hz Gaming Monitor

Elevate your competitive gameplay to the next level with the AOC 27G11ZE2 27 Inch gaming monitor, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Built with a fast-paced Full HD 1920x1080 Fast IPS display, this monitor delivers breathtaking visual performance alongside wide 178-degree viewing angles. Engineered for elite esports performance, it handles heavy action frames smoothly with an ultra-responsive 240Hz refresh rate and a blistering 0.3ms MPRT response time to prevent motion blur and ghosting. It offers remarkable color accuracy covering 123% sRGB and 92% DCI-P3 spectrums, enhanced by HDR10 rendering for rich imagery. Featuring Adaptive Sync for tear-free gaming, Low Input Lag, and a 3-sided frameless setup ideal for expansive battle stations. This reliable pro-gaming monitor comes backed by a comprehensive 3-year warranty setup.
